title: Accelerating Approximate Analytical Join Queries over Unstructured Data with Statistical Guarantees
authors: Yuxuan Zhu, Tengjun Jin, Chenghao Mo, Daniel Kang
venue: Proc. ACM Manag. Data, Vol. 4, No. 3 (SIGMOD 2026), Article 127 · https://doi.org/10.1145/3802004
description: JoinML accelerates analytical join queries over unstructured data with LLM/ML join predicates. Weighted Wander Join (WWJ) turns embeddings into approximate indices for importance sampling, and Blocking-augmented Sampling (BaS) splits the space into a blocking regime and a sampling regime, adaptively allocating an Oracle budget to deliver valid confidence intervals while cutting RMSE by up to 19x.
